## Checklist

- [ ] Issue has exactly one assignee; branch is `type/<issue-number>-slug` from latest `dev`.
- [ ] This feature/fix/docs PR targets `dev` (a milestone release alone uses `dev` → `main`).
- [ ] Small English Conventional Commits; G0 passed before push.
- [ ] No `node_modules`, `dist`, secrets or draft files in the diff.
- [ ] Evidence and repeatable verification match this revision.
- [ ] Relevant module/contract owner requested; at least one other person must approve before merge.
